verdict.rationale: Oneleet's framework-removal docs say controls are added automatically per framework and stay when another framework also requires them, so a single control and its evidence are shared across frameworks. The platform also supports SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA. However, nothing documents an explicit cross-framework mapping, automatic crediting of SOC 2 work toward ISO 27001 or HIPAA, or any view of the overlap. Missing for 10: documented control-to-requirement mapping across frameworks, an explicit statement that evidence counts automatically toward multiple frameworks, an overlap or coverage visualization, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, controls and evidence map ACROSS frameworks — work done for SOC 2 counts toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA automatically, with the overlap shown

citations.quote: Controls stay when another framework requires them or when they contain work such as evidence, review history, assignments, or custom content.
Whether you need SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, or another framework.
